item.title: Experience
item.description:
Baughman Kroup Bosse, PLLC — Financial Analyst (07/2024 – Present)

  • Lead firm-level budget development supporting executive decision-making in planning, client acquisition evaluation, and staffing optimization.
  • Own monthly potential business write-off analysis; present findings and recommendations to executive leadership.
  • Architect and deploy NetSuite dashboards delivering real-time visibility across revenue and expense metrics.
  • Oversee daily reconciliation and posting of credit card transactions, ensuring data integrity across systems.
  • Design and implement ERP process improvements and system integrations to streamline workflows and improve reporting efficiency.

Allegiant Airlines — Staff Accountant, Revenue (05/2023 – 05/2024)

  • Managed daily revenue journal entries supporting approximately $2B in annual revenue within a publicly traded, high-volume environment.
  • Conducted structured inflight revenue audits to ensure transactional accuracy and compliance.
  • Reconciled air traffic liability accounts, strengthening deferred revenue visibility and reporting accuracy.
  • Designed and implemented automated revenue reporting workflows, reducing manual processing time by ~25%.
  • Partnered cross-functionally with finance, operations, and external stakeholders to ensure accurate billing and commission payments.
  • Participated in cross-functional ERP migration testing and validation during transition from internal systems to SAP, supporting system readiness and data integrity verification.

MGM Resorts — Internal Audit, Data Analyst Intern (01/2022 – 05/2023)

  • Developed self-service reporting tools supporting internal audit analytics and risk assessment.
  • Automated audit documentation workflows to improve efficiency and standardization.
  • Extracted, validated, and visualized financial and operational datasets.

item.title: Projects
item.description:
Data Automation & Workflow Engineering

I build structured, reliable workflows that improve financial data integrity, reduce manual effort, and increase reporting confidence. My work focuses on reconciliation, ERP reporting, and operational finance processes — applying a systems mindset to ensure accuracy at scale.

Automated Revenue Reporting Workflow (Allegiant Airlines)

Problem: Manual daily reporting workflows created bottlenecks and increased risk of inconsistencies across datasets.
Approach: Designed an automated reporting workflow that standardized inputs, validated data integrity, and produced consistent daily outputs for revenue operations.
Impact: Reduced manual processing time by ~25% while improving reporting reliability.
Tools: SQL, Power Query, PowerShell, Excel
